source.label: Steam official RSS/API plus official update hub recheck

sources.claim: The official RSS feed lists Tokyo Game Show on 2026-09-17, Archer Balance Reverted on 2026-09-13, and [Update] v0.4.23 on 2026-09-12 as the latest official entries.
The official Steam news API returns the same current boundary: Tokyo Game Show, Archer Balance Reverted, and [Update] v0.4.23, followed by the older v0.4.19 and v0.4.17 notes.

The official v0.4.23 note separates Lock Consecration Results, restores Region 1/2 Soulstone merchant conditions, disables ally-damaging skill Auto Use by default, lowers Active Skill Energy on Normal/Easy, raises maximum expedition size to 6 at Rank 2 and 8 at Rank 3, reveals an attacking enemy tile briefly, and changes high-difficulty Research Work Amount multipliers from 1.33x/1.66x to 1.15x/1.30x.

The official Archer Balance Reverted announcement says the v0.4.23 Archer changes were reverted for Rapid Fire, Arrow Rain, Sniping Shot, and Sharp Shooter; it is a balance announcement and does not create a new numbered version.
The latest dated official announcement is a Tokyo Game Show appearance notice; it contains no numbered version or guide-mechanic change.
The official store still presents Dungeon Settlers as an Early Access game and provides the current product identity; it does not override the numbered update boundary.

The local source scanner timed out on the Community Hub and three direct legacy announcement URLs; the official RSS/API and update-hub evidence above were used instead, so the local scan remains partial.

changes.summary: Update the first-run and planner boundary for v0.4.23 expedition size, combat defaults, energy costs, and visibility behavior.

evidence.claim: The official v0.4.23 note changes maximum expedition size, ally-damaging skill Auto Use defaults, Active Skill Energy by Combat Difficulty, and outside-vision attacker tile visibility.

changes.fact: v0.4.23 raises the maximum expedition size to 6 members at Rank 2 and 8 at Rank 3, disables Auto Use by default for skills that can damage allies, reduces Active Skill Energy costs on Normal and Easy, and briefly reveals an enemy tile when it attacks from outside vision.
changes.impact: The first expedition guidance and planner must not keep the prior implicit party-size/combat-default boundary; no new route or hidden optimal party order is inferred.

changes.summary: Replace the outdated high-difficulty Research Work Amount multipliers in the guide boundary while preserving the version-locked table warning.

evidence.claim: The official v0.4.23 note changes Research Work Amount multipliers on Very Hard from 1.33x to 1.15x and Devastation from 1.66x to 1.30x.

changes.fact: The official v0.4.23 note reports Very Hard Research Work Amount 1.15x and Devastation 1.30x; the separate DS_B.0.4.19 data extraction remains a dated secondary snapshot and is not silently upgraded.
changes.impact: Research guidance can state the current official multiplier correction, but the full Research table and universal order remain version-locked or pending.

changes.summary: Record the Archer Balance Reverted announcement as a current balance correction without treating it as a new numbered release.

evidence.claim: The official announcement reverts the listed Archer balance values introduced in v0.4.23 and does not state a new numbered version.

changes.fact: Archer balance values were reverted after v0.4.23 feedback; this is an announcement-level correction, not a new version boundary.
changes.impact: The update record should link the correction and keep detailed Archer numbers out of unrelated evergreen guides.

changes.summary: Show the latest Tokyo Game Show announcement as announcement-only context with no claimed gameplay impact.

evidence.claim: The latest official dated entry announces Tokyo Game Show attendance and does not publish a numbered version or gameplay change.

changes.fact: The latest dated official announcement is an event notice, while v0.4.23 remains the current numbered boundary.
changes.impact: The update page can state the announcement boundary without making the event sound like a mechanic update.

changes.summary: Make the older version-locked Research database snapshot explicit after the official v0.4.23 recheck.

evidence.claim: The official v0.4.23 note changes Research Work Amount, while the repository's extracted Research table is explicitly labeled DS_B.0.4.19.

changes.fact: The site can verify v0.4.23 update facts, but its full Research data extraction remains DS_B.0.4.19 and requires a separate re-extraction before being presented as current.
changes.impact: Only the visible evidence boundary changes now; no database rows are rewritten from an unverified source.

unknowns.fact: The full Research table corresponding to v0.4.23 was not re-extracted in this source recheck.
unknowns.impact: Keep the DS_B.0.4.19 database snapshot version-locked and do not infer a universal Research order or current row values.

unknowns.fact: The local scanner could not fetch the Community Hub or three direct legacy announcement URLs within the timeout.
unknowns.impact: The source snapshot remains partial even though official RSS, API, and the official update-hub content provide verified current evidence.
